A '''hepatizon mattock''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[mattock]], made by smithing a [[Copper Hoe|copper hoe]] with [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]]. It mines at speed 15 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the hepatizon shovel or hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a [[Copper Mattock|copper mattock]] works as the base as well as a copper hoe. Without the template, the same base and alloy make a [[Hepatizon Hoe|hepatizon hoe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/hepatizon/mattock</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 15. Hepatizon has the highest base mining speeds of any tier.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 3 damage with an attack speed of 3.

Held in the main hand, it adds 0.005 to movement speed (5% of the base speed).

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_mattock.json}}</ref>
